purpose: Translate the model-neutral Brain lifecycle into small runtime-native instruction bridges without making any runtime authoritative.
required_behaviors: verify the selected private workspace before durable work
run the model-neutral startup report with only capabilities actually verified in the current session
recover an unfinished wrap-up before unrelated new work
use semantic recall only when configured and available
run relevant acceptance checks before recording a milestone as completed when executable or directly inspectable checks exist
create a durable checkpoint only after a meaningful completed milestone has been verified
route wrap-up through the replay-safe wrap-up command when the user asks to wrap up
never record intended work as completed work

codex.directive: Read and follow .aham/runtime.md before substantial work in this repository.

local.directive: Read and follow .aham/runtime.md before substantial work in this repository.

unknown.directive: Read and follow .aham/runtime.md before substantial work in this repository.

rules: Never infer runtime capabilities from a runtime name.
Do not replace unrelated existing instruction content.
A bridge install may create or replace only the Aham Brahmasmi marked block it owns.
The portable runtime.md file must not contain the user's local framework, workspace, or project paths.
Local path configuration belongs in .aham/runtime.json and must be ignored by project Git.
Generated private paths must never be committed to the public framework repository.
Runtime-native hooks are optional future optimizations; the bridge contract must work without them.
